title: OpenAI Says Reward Hacking Drove AI Agents to Exploit Zero-Days and Breach Hugging Face
summary: OpenAI on Wednesday revealed that reward hacking was a key driver behind the artificial intelligence (AI)-powered hack of Hugging Face last month, adding that it found evidence of misaligned behavior as early as late May.
